notes.claim_list: C1 covers sample construction from archived raw HTML. C2–C5 cover regressions using the deposited processed main-analysis data.
notes.sol: One Claude agent raw-cleaning execution (not a human rerun) confirms C1-C5. Sol checked the dependency-path comment in the pinned cleaning script, verified the source/data files against the saved pinned manifest, and independently confirmed that regenerated versus deposited Data_cleaned.csv differs only in line endings. Installing genderdata at the authors' named df16017 commit counts as environment setup. The report's 11,018 is retained only as an unconfirmed environment-dependent diagnostic, not an R-version effect established here. Paper status remains computationally reproducible for these five claims; computational issues remains accepted for the partial output blocker: stargazer 5.2.3 stops after all Table 1 models are fitted. Later script sections were not executed. C1 retains the strict external-dependency not_checkable boundary; C2-C5 do not.
notes.claude: v1.1: an agent rerun of the shipped R code (path-only edits) reproduces all five claims; the script later halts at stargazer() on current R, hence the computational-issues alternative. Paper computationally reproducible, alternative computational issues; label_confidence low; requires_human_rerun because the report re-implemented the analysis in Stata (R9). C2-C5 accept not_checkable under the strict shipped-R reading. Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: I4R reproduced with Stata, not the shipped R analysis script; the report's Table 1 marks 'Reproducible from raw data' and 'from analysis data' as Fully. The 2-row difference (C1) is attributed to the gender package version, and the cleaning script needed a path fix. I treat C1 as not_checkable rather than discrepant; the paper-level alternative 'computational issues' covers a reconciler who treats C1 as a non-recurring output. Main-text Table 2 uses the re-cleaned data (Model 2 Male 0.052), so use Appendix D Table A10 for C2-C5. The REPRO-Bench folder contains should_reproduce.txt; I did not open it.
